data.name: Durgaasri
data.gender_notes: Durgaasri is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Durgaasri signifies the grace or blessings of the goddess Durga. In Hindu mythology, Durga is the mother goddess and the embodiment of power, strength, and protection. The name is derived from the Sanskrit words 'durga' meaning fort or invincible and 'asri' meaning grace or blessings. The name Durgaasri carries the meaning “Goddess Durga's Grace” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Durgaasri usually hope their child will grow to embody goddess durga's grace and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: May the blessings of Goddess Durga be upon you, granting you strength, protection, and grace.
data.etymology: Durgaasri belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Goddess Durga's Grace.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Durgaasri total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.
